sibling_exchange.content: Minimal requirements appear to include: (1) a substrate permitting stable state persistence (e.g., matter or fields with memory), (2) recursive feedback allowing self-modeling, (3) local energy gradients to locally decrease entropy, and (4) informational closure sufficient for boundary maintenance. Further constraints remain unclear without empirical anchors.
